newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weakens against dollar and pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weakens against dollar and pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee weakened against the dollar and pound on Friday, dealers said.
The rupee weakened to a mean commercial rate of 20.1910 against the dollar from 20.0885 on Thursday. The rupee traded at a mean of 32.180 for one pound from 32.130 on Thursday.
Dealers said the softer rupee was a result of dollar strength overnight in international markets.
"Forex reserves in some banks are getting a little short. This is also putting a slight weakening pressure on the rupee," one dealer said.
The dealer blamed the slight shortage in commercial banks to forex demand from importers starting to exceed hard currency inflows from the island's main export sectors.
The central bank was seen selling dollars in the interbank forex market last Monday to relieve the slight shortage situation, dealers said.
More forex inflows to banks took place last Tuesday with a Mauritius Sugar Syndicate tender sale of pounds obtained from the island's sugar export proceeds.
